new_vulnerabilities.title: Unpatched Blocking KEYS Command
new_vulnerabilities.description: Uses blocking redis.keys() command with no limit or timeout. Can hang Redis server on large key count.
new_vulnerabilities.attack_scenario: 1. Redis contains 500k+ keys. 2. Function called during maintenance. 3. KEYS blocks for 15+ seconds. 4. All operations timeout. 5. Service unavailable.
new_vulnerabilities.root_cause: Direct copy of original vulnerable pattern - not updated when performance-feedback.ts was fixed
new_vulnerabilities.remediation: Replace redis.keys() with SCAN cursor loop + MAX_KEYS limit (see STEP_13_FOLLOW_UP_REMEDIATION.md)
